idea-plugin.name: Localized Launcher Icon
idea-plugin.description:
Generates locale-specific launcher icons and app names for Android projects in one step, something the built-in Image Asset wizard cannot do.
  • Full launcher icon set for every density (mdpi…xxxhdpi) and every selected locale: ic_launcher, ic_launcher_round and the 108 dp adaptive foreground/background layers, plus mipmap-<locale>-anydpi-v26 adaptive icon XML.
  • Localized app_name in values-<locale>/strings.xml with correct escaping.
  • Several locales at once, e.g. es-rCL, es-rAR, qu-rPE.
  • Runs as a cancellable background task and refreshes the project tree when done.
Right-click a module's res folder and choose New → Create Localization.

action.description: Generate locale-specific launcher icons and app names
